_readme: Everything under assets/props, assets/storybook/equipment and hero wearables, plus every MapTypes.ALL_PROP_KINDS entry, must either be a catalog object (content/objects/<category>/obj.*.json) or appear here with a reason. See docs/SYSTEMS/OBJECT_CATALOG.md.
